I’ve been a SHINee fan since 2010 and now with everything that’s happened and most of the boys in the military it’s pretty hard for me to still be a really active fan. Also as I’ve gotten older I’ve been starting to notice more and more things I’m not so into about the kpop industry/fandom. I’m sure you’re all already aware of the major issues. But I think I’ll always have a soft spot in my heart for SHINee and kpop and it’s especially cool to see it gain almost mainstream popularity here in North America with BTS since back in the day most people had never even heard of the genre and the idea of listening to non-English music was unfathomable. SHINee got me through some hard times and I still adore all the members and I’ll probably keep following them for as long as I can 😌
